# Tables by markers

```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
# print count tables
counter=0
for (tbl in cnt.tables) {
  counter = (counter+1) %% 2
  print(tbl)
  if (counter==0) cat("\\newpage") #put two tables on one page
}
```


# Tables by biopsies


```{r count and density tables, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
table_files <- list.files("output/tables/input/", pattern = ".*_counts+.*1000\\.tex$", full.names = TRUE)
for (f in table_files) cat(paste0("\\input{", f, "}\n\\newpage"))
```
